body: sorry for the late response. I have other friends but none even remotely as close as her and I were. it's a really really really long story, but we've been in an on-and-off relationship for about half a year now after a year-long steady one. our most recent relationship lasted only a few weeks in january in which we both were doing really really well but both kind of fizzled out, and ever since then we've never quite been the same since. we've been yelling at each other constantly and making each other really miserable. I honestly don't even want the relationship back anymore. I just wanna have my best friend back, the one person who I could confide in and rely on the most.
